rules.description: Applicant must have a National Insurance number
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a National Insurance number to apply for NI credits

rules.description: Applicant must be under State Pension age
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot receive National Insurance credits after reaching State Pension age

rules.description: Must not be married woman paying reduced rate National Insurance
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot usually get credits if you're a married woman paying reduced rate National Insurance

rules.description: Must be in a qualifying situation (unemployed, caring, ill, parenting, on UC/JSA/ESA, etc.)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be in a qualifying situation to receive NI credits. Check the guidance to see if your circumstances qualify.

rules.description: Must have gaps in National Insurance record to fill
rules.reason_if_failed: NI credits fill gaps in your record. Check your NI record online to see if you have any gaps.

rules.description: For carer's credits (when not on Carer's Allowance): must care for 20+ hours per week
rules.reason_if_failed: You must care for one or more sick or disabled person for at least 20 hours per week to qualify for carer's credits

explanation_template: National Insurance credits eligibility: {outcome}. Situation: {qualifying_situation}. Credit type: {credit_type} (Class 1 counts toward State Pension and other benefits; Class 3 counts toward State Pension only)

edge_cases.description: Conviction quashed by Court of Appeal (or Court of Criminal Appeal in Scotland)
edge_cases.action: Manual application required. Write to HMRC PT Operations North East England, BX9 1AN with National Insurance number, dates, and details of quashed conviction. Class 1 credits may be awarded.

edge_cases.description: Married to or civil partner of armed forces member on overseas posting
edge_cases.action: Class 1 credits for postings after 6 April 2010. Class 3 for postings after 6 April 1975 if reaching State Pension age on or after 6 April 2016. Separate application required.

edge_cases.description: Transferring Child Benefit credits between spouses/partners
edge_cases.action: Parent/guardian registered for Child Benefit can transfer Class 3 credits to spouse/partner living with them if donor has paid a qualifying year of NI contributions. Separate application required.

edge_cases.description: Home Responsibilities Protection for periods before 6 April 2010
edge_cases.action: Claim HRP to get Class 3 credits for periods between 6 April 1978 and 5 April 2010 where Child Benefit received for child under 16 but HRP not automatically awarded. Separate application required.

edge_cases.description: On Statutory Sick/Maternity/Paternity/Adoption Pay but earnings insufficient for qualifying year
edge_cases.action: Manual application required. Write to HMRC PT Operations North East England, BX9 1AN with NI number, dates, and pay details. Class 1 credits may be awarded.

edge_cases.description: On government-approved training course not arranged by Jobcentre Plus
edge_cases.action: Manual application if over 18 and course lasts no longer than 1 year. Write to HMRC PT Operations North East England, BX9 1AN with NI number, course details, and dates. Class 1 credits may be awarded.

edge_cases.description: Grandparent or eligible family member caring for child under 12
edge_cases.action: Apply for Specified Adult Childcare Class 3 credits if: eligible family member over 16 but under State Pension age, cared for child under 12 since 6 April 2011, child's parent/guardian has Child Benefit and agrees to transfer. Separate application required.
